prompt: A satirical cartoon still in sharp scratchy pen and flat watercolour, where the closer people are to the money, the more distorted they are drawn. The old woman and the crowds are drawn plainly with tired human faces. The gangsters are swollen round bodies with tiny heads; the mayor is stretched impossibly tall and thin with a huge grin full of teeth. Everyone has an ordinary nose. A tall city building cut open in cross-section like a doll's house, seen straight on, four floors from the top down. Attic: an old woman in a coat shivers by one candle in an ice blue room. Street level: a bakery with cream and brick red walls; a crowd in red scarves and a crowd in blue scarves, mixed ages and skin tones, shove each other under a street lamp, a police car beside them. Basement: in emerald lamplight, printing presses with cheerful faces throw banknotes while gangsters in pinstripe suits play music and a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat and gold chain dances. Bottom: an orange furnace. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
